chats.answer:
To run an induction cooktop with a portable power station, I recommend looking for a unit with at least 2,000W continuous AC output and a pure sine wave inverter.

Most portable induction cooktops draw 1,200–1,800W, so smaller power stations may overload or shut down.

What size power station do you need?

These estimates assume continuous full-power cooking and roughly 85% usable energy after inverter losses. Actual cooking time can be longer because induction cooktops often cycle power or operate at lower settings.

All three below can run a typical 1,800W, 120V induction cooktop.
